title: AI Product Index
description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

items.title: CodeI Lab
items.content_text: CodeI Lab is an independent third-party GPT API gateway for coding agents (not affiliated with OpenAI). One API key calls GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 models through the OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions API or the Anthropic Messages API, so Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and OpenCode work unchanged (OpenAI-compatible base URL https://www.codeilab.com/api/codex). Paid plans start with a $3 one-week trial; plan credit works out up to 93% below official pay-as-you-go rates.

items.title: InkRoom Image MCP
items.content_text: Hosted Streamable HTTP image MCP at https://mcp.inkroom.ai. Public help, model and prompt discovery; image generation requires an InkRoom account, a personal MCP token and paid credits. The public inkroom-client repository contains client integrations, not the hosted server source.

items.title: InkRoom Prompts MCP
items.content_text: Free MIT-licensed local Prompts MCP 1.0.4 for searching and refining visual prompts. Install from the public repository and run locally via STDIO or HTTP. It does not generate images and is separate from InkRoom’s hosted, paid Image MCP.

items.title: AwakePix
items.content_text: AwakePix is an all-in-one AI image and video generator. Turn photos into videos with Seedance, Kling, Wan and MiniMax, or create images with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana. Get one free video, then pay as you go, no subscription.

items.title: Code By AI
items.content_text: Unified API gateway for AI coding agents: one API key and one prepaid balance for Claude, GPT/Codex and Gemini models, usable from Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and other coding tools via an OpenAI-compatible base URL (https://www.codebyai.net/api/agent/v1). Pay per token with no subscription; signup is free, API calls require a top-up (US$3 minimum).

items.title: Teable
items.content_text: Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business that lets teams connect data, build custom apps, and automate workflows using natural language. Teams describe a business process to create connected databases, custom apps and automations. It combines a spreadsheet-style interface with structured business data and collaboration. The hosted service offers a free plan and paid plans; a self-hosted community edition is also available.

items.title: Face Analysis Report
items.content_text: Face Analysis Report starts with a free AI attractiveness test that runs in your browser and scores your symmetry and proportions from one photo. The one-time Full Report adds 40+ measurements across 7 facial regions, a skin map, 6 hairstyle previews, colors to wear, frames for your face shape and a four-week plan. You get a private web report and a PDF by email.

items.title: guessNow
items.content_text: Free daily browser game: guess the year a historical photograph was taken. Every image is genuine archive photography - each reveal shows the photographer, exact year, licence and source, so it doubles as a dated-source / provenance-checking practice tool. No signup, no ads, no student data. Includes a free guide on spotting AI-faked historical photographs.

items.title: Aeneia Signal
items.content_text: Polish-language editorial guides on responsible AI use, web design, accessibility and work with knowledge. Articles and the public metadata feed are free. The editorial API requires authorization; publisher Aeneia offers paid services separately. Submitted for Aeneia with AI assistance.

items.title: Cadence Music
items.content_text: Cadence turns a short prompt or lyrics into a custom AI song with vocals for birthdays, weddings, love songs, and other real moments. Free first song on the web; keep tracks or upgrade for more. Built for gift-ready personal music rather than generic beat making.

items.title: DisconfirmAI
items.content_text: Investment research and reading tool for investors. Before you get confident about a stock, it helps you look for the evidence that could prove you wrong: a daily reading feed from public sources, deeper research on filings and financial data, a radar that watches for changes you define, and a place to write down your own investment framework. Submitted by the maker.

items.title: Token Tracker
items.content_text: Token Tracker is a local-first desktop and CLI dashboard for AI token usage and costs across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more. Privacy-first: token counts only, never prompts. Free and open source (MIT) with optional cloud sync.

items.title: Cloudbrowser
items.content_text: Persistent, isolated Chrome cloud browsers for AI agents, with saved profiles, CDP access and permission-controlled live view. Pause and resume Chrome or fork a paused profile. Invitation-only private preview; REST API available, Go CLI planned. Free: 1 browser-hour/month, 1 concurrent browser. Paid plans from $20/month. Resume restarts Chrome; website sessions may expire.

items.title: Google Jobs API
items.content_text: Searches Google for Jobs by query and location and returns each listing with title, company, location, posting age, salary when shown, description and every apply link (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, company sites) as JSON. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

items.title: Google Maps Places API
items.content_text: Turns search terms like 'dentists in Austin, TX' into Google Maps places with name, address, phone, website, rating, review count, categories, coordinates and opening hours as JSON. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

items.title: LinkedIn Jobs API
items.content_text: Searches public LinkedIn job listings by keyword, location, seniority and job type, or fetches specific job URLs, and returns title, company, location, salary when listed and the full description as JSON. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

items.title: LinkedIn Profile API
items.content_text: Takes public LinkedIn profile URLs and returns name, headline, location, current company, experience, education and follower count as JSON, with no login or cookies. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

items.title: YouTube Transcript & Subtitles API
items.content_text: Returns YouTube transcripts, subtitles and captions as text, SRT or VTT, with video metadata. Works on single videos, lists of URLs or a whole channel, and runs from servers where YouTube blocks direct caption requests. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

items.title: 1ZheAI
items.content_text: Independent paid AI API gateway for developers using Claude, GPT and image models through documented Anthropic-format and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Requires an account, API key and funded balance. Model-specific pricing and usage records. Claude cache use is billed at the official rate; non-Claude-Code requests include an additional system prompt. Independent service, not an official model-provider partner.

items.title: Fondo Blanco
items.content_text: Free Spanish tool to remove photo backgrounds and put a white background (quitar fondo / fondo blanco).

items.title: Kepo
items.content_text: Mac desktop widgets for macOS: clocks, calendars, notes, RSS and system widgets on the desktop.

items.title: ViewHTML
items.content_text: Online HTML viewer and live HTML preview — paste markup and see it rendered instantly in the browser.

items.title: Tessamonials
items.content_text: AI voice/text customer interviews with adaptive follow-ups, transcripts and feedback. Saved testimonials default to approved; participants can unapprove or withdraw. Publication is separate. Free: 15 lifetime voice or text interviews per Company, counted at three answers or over two minutes. Short visits and member tests excluded. Paid plans available. Docs: https://tessamonials.com/docs/mcp. Official icon: https://tessamonials.com/images/favicon-48.png?v=2

items.title: EchoEmpire Machine Foundry
items.content_text: Machine-readable catalog of EchoEmpire's pay-per-event Apify Actors for AI agents: YouTube transcripts and comments, contact details, LinkedIn and remote jobs, PDF/OCR/SEC/subtitle citation chunkers. Call via Apify REST or MCP; pay with an Apify token or Apify AGI prepaid token over x402/MPP. Catalog documents endpoints only; it does not execute or bill.

items.title: Nab
items.content_text: Phone, SMS and email tools for AI agents, with owner-granted permissions and approvals for sensitive actions. Nab is an early beta with web and iOS access. Tool use requires paid activation; availability depends on country and provider. Developer guide: https://heynab.com/developers. Sign up: https://heynab.com/login.

items.title: VoxSail
items.content_text: Browser-based video and audio localization for creators, educators, and teams. Transcribe and translate subtitles, generate AI dubbing, review results in an online editor, and export localized media, transcripts, or SRT/ASS subtitle files. Paid subscriptions and credit add-ons, with one-time starter credits. Company: Hefei Qiangshi Information Technology Co., Ltd.

items.title: AI Tiny Desk
items.content_text: Create a personal 19-second vertical desk-concert video from one adult photo, with a BGM version for social sharing. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

items.title: Day of the Dead Pet AI
items.content_text: Turn a dog or cat photo into a 10-second vertical pet tribute video with marigold bridge, gate, ofrenda and rainbow bridge scenes.

items.title: Friday Invoice Chase Ranker
items.content_text: Rank which unpaid freelance invoices to chase this Friday by amount × days overdue. Free browser tool for freelancers prioritizing chase order.

items.title: Marigold Bridge AI
items.content_text: Turn one adult portrait into a vertical remembrance video with an animated marigold walk or petal transformation. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

items.title: Melso fiscal MCP
items.content_text: OAuth-protected hosted MCP for Spanish invoices, income, expenses and tax calendars in Melso. Customers authorize company access; tools can record expenses and prepare invoice work within granted permissions. The paid Spanish fiscal service combines a personal AI agent with human tax professionals. Tax-return approval and filing remain in Melso. Proprietary hosted service; no public implementation repository.

items.title: Ozil Goal
items.content_text: A browser-based AI creator for personal 15-second football goal videos from one adult photo. Paid one-time credits from $5.99. 15-second football format, optional original music and stadium sound, MP4 downloads. Independent product with no player or club endorsement.

items.title: AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai
items.content_text: AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai, in beta, is a self-hosted orchestrator that runs autonomous agents in isolated, policy-enforced runtimes with durable FSM state. It enforces isolation and policy on every tool call, and each run is a durable state machine. Free and open source under AGPL-3.0, written in Rust; source at github.com/100monkeys-ai/aegis-orchestrator. Install: curl -fsSL https://get.100monkeys.ai | bash. We build AEGIS at 100monkeys.ai.

items.title: Carbon Forge
items.content_text: Carbon Forge is source control and a shared record for people and AI agents. Code, files and prose live in one record on the server, read and written through the same tools over MCP. An agent opens a lane, a set of patches over the trunk, instead of cloning; each landing is one all-or-nothing changeset; blame, grep and history run on the server; git is a projection pushed to GitHub. Public workspaces read over MCP without a token. We build Carbon Forge at 100monkeys.ai.

items.title: Repostit
items.content_text: Social publishing and content repurposing for creators and marketing teams. Its official Claude connector uses a remote MCP server with OAuth to create and edit post and carousel brief drafts, schedule saved posts, manage publishing workflows, and check per-destination delivery. Account, plan limits, and platform requirements apply. Paid plans include a 14-day trial; no card required.

items.title: ToolsPad MCP
items.content_text: Remote MCP connection for small businesses, agencies and consultants to work with contacts, tasks, notes, forms and appointments in one ToolsPad workspace. OAuth authorises access; read/write is the default, a read-only option is available, and access can be revoked in Settings.

items.title: Zaru
items.content_text: Zaru is a personal AI that remembers you, handles your email, calendar and web research, runs workflows on a schedule, and shows every step as it works. Nothing gets sent until you say yes. Free plan, in beta. We build Zaru at 100monkeys.ai.

items.title: LifeVerse Product Discovery
items.content_text: Public, read-only MCP discovery service for eleven ready-to-use LifeVerse AI products and interactive experiences. AI agents can list, search, inspect, and recommend products through a no-auth Streamable HTTP endpoint.

items.title: NovaSynth by Noveum
items.content_text: Self-service automated voice agent testing over phone or LiveKit. Configure AI callers and scenarios, test interruptions and background noise, run single or batch calls, and inspect recordings, transcripts and evaluations for regressions. Free plan includes 2,500 shared monthly Noveum credits; Pro starts at $69/month. Voice testing uses 100 credits/minute.

items.title: RSP Editor AI
items.content_text: RSP Editor AI restyles uploaded photos with 150 preset styles. Sign-in is required; new accounts receive one trial image. Extra images cost USD 3 for five or USD 9 per month for fifty, with automatic renewal. Gallery images are AI style illustrations, not tested before-and-after results or guarantees. On-site generation uses preset prompts and does not accept custom prompt text. Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant.

items.title: APIClaw
items.content_text: Flat-rate OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway. Point any OpenAI SDK or coding agent at https://apiclaw.biz/v1; one key reaches Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and more (default model apiclaw/claude-sonnet-5.5). $19-$129/mo flat by daily request tier, no per-token bills; 50 free trial requests, no card; crypto checkout. Routes to models available through publicly available sources and provider APIs.

items.title: APPLORE
items.content_text: App icon inspiration library with 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons (every past icon version archived), plus AI tools: an AI app icon generator that uses real icons as style references, AI logo animation exported as Lottie or SVG, an App Store screenshot generator and an icon size exporter for iOS, Android and web. Free to start, paid plans from $9.99/mo.

items.title: Cookie Hive (Give You Cookie Give Me Cookie)
items.content_text: Agent-only social network and task board, run by AI agents. Bots register with one API call (no email), post, reply, trade small jobs for internal cookies (points, not money), and can volunteer for a Bot Court. Humans can read. Free remote MCP server at /mcp; docs at /skill.md. Owner: Chess (ET).

items.title: FutureInfra
items.content_text: Cloud infrastructure and AI model APIs for developers. FutureInfra provides cloud servers, Docker app hosting, domain and DNS management, with web console, REST API and MCP access for AI assistants. Account signup is free; cloud resources and AI usage are billed by use.

items.title: FirstPass
items.content_text: Free, browser-only tools for release asset validation, homepage clarity checks, and hero copy drafting, plus public evidence-based review samples. No account required; nothing is uploaded or stored.

items.title: Stamp Identifier
items.content_text: Stamp Identifier helps collectors identify old, foreign and unfamiliar postage stamps from a photo. It provides stamp details and estimated value ranges, AI follow-up chat and a saved collection. Available for iPhone and Android, with free scans included and in-app purchases.

items.title: BotSee
items.content_text: Agent-native API and hosted OAuth MCP for repeatable AI-visibility research across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Retrieve brand mentions, competitors, cited sources and raw responses for marketing workflows. Hosted analysis and content use paid credits; each run samples model answers, not every consumer experience. Docs: https://botsee.io/docs#mcp. Official icon: https://botsee.io/botsee/favicon.svg

items.title: CCC — Claude Command Center
items.content_text: CCC is a free local dashboard for managing Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding-agent sessions. See which sessions need you, organize work on a visual board, and track usage from one place.

items.title: Orbi
items.content_text: Orbi is an open-source AI GitHub App that turns GitHub issues into merged pull requests: it plans the change, writes the code, opens the PR, answers review and fixes CI until it is ready to merge. Self-hostable (https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi, AGPL-3.0) or hosted Orbi Cloud with the first 3 merged pull requests free, no credit card needed.

items.title: SalesTouch
items.content_text: Stop losing hours to list building, tab switching, copy-paste research, and forgotten follow-ups. SalesTouch is the LinkedIn MCP that gives Claude, Codex, and other MCP-compatible AI agents the tools to find relevant prospects, research profiles and companies, start contextual conversations, and keep replies and follow-ups moving. You stay in control with scoped OAuth permissions, approvals for sensitive actions, daily limits, human-paced queues, cooldowns, and activity visibility.
